cap: A sexual health visit starts from behavior and anatomy, not identity. The 5 Ps and the question about which body parts partners use decide which sites to test: urethra, vagina or neovagina, rectum and throat. Protection adds PrEP and HPV vaccination. A transgender man on testosterone still needs contraception, because amenorrhea does not prove that ovulation has stopped, and a levonorgestrel IUD or implant avoids estrogen.
